requirements.statement: One package-driven Bevy application host activates the reopened runtime image for client and GPU-free headless execution.
acceptance: The same final lock starts client and headless without hidden Terrenia fallbacks.
Fixed tick, async derived work and shutdown remain bounded under the accepted budgets.

requirements.statement: Authoritative entity movement, targeting and collision remain equivalent across client and headless while presentation stays derived.
acceptance: Y-up movement, six-face targeting and collider replacement pass at negative coordinates.
Presentation or device faults cannot change authoritative receipts.
